card.name: Zionist history text, voting and support words
card.fires_on: Small words like for, the, of in passages on early Zionist and Jewish settlement history in Palestine, especially vote counts for parties at a Zionist congress.

modes.label: Vote tallies
modes.description: Words like for and the inside a list of how many voted for each Zionist party.
modes.example: 55 Zionists voted for the nineteenth Zionist congress as follows: 20<< for>> the Labor party

modes.label: Other Zionist history
modes.description: Linking words in text about institutions, funds and settlement of the Land of Israel.
modes.example: explorations done on behalf of<< the>> Hebrew University.

card.writes: It slightly favors words built on "mand" such as mandate and mandatory, which fit the British Mandate era.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in old Zionist and Palestine history, especially party vote counts.
